title: The News Dropping The Market Right Now?!
speaker: Ricky Gutierrez

macro_themes.view: Reuters: investors trimming Anthropic's expected IPO valuation from ~$2T to ~$1.5T, shaking an already nervous AI tape.
Kevin Warsh speaking at 8:30; hawkish tone on top of valuation doubts could mean a second leg down.
BTC dip began before the Anthropic headline; unverified report MSCI removing Strategy (MSTR) from its indexes.

calls.condition: If futures gap down at the reopen on the Anthropic news, the worry is real; a hawkish Warsh adds a second leg down; if neutral, the drop probably fades.
calls.reason: After-hours AI sell-off on Anthropic IPO valuation cut amid CoreWeave financing concerns; advises small size, no leverage.
calls.quote: remember, markets can get worse before they get better.

notes: Much of the commentary is from an AI news assistant ('coin flip leaning cautious'); Ricky's own stance is cautious buy-the-dip with small size. Recorded overnight/extended hours (futures break 5-6pm ET); Warsh speech the next morning. CoreWeave 16.7% intraday swing noted but no bias given.
